subject: Quantile runway & staged upgrade proposal — usage forecast + pilot SOW
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Maggie Zhao <maggie@quantile.ai>, Evan Lin <procurement@quantile.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Usage health + staged upgrade proposal

Hi Maggie / Evan,

Thanks again for the call today — great walkthrough of Quantile’s traffic patterns. As promised, I ran a short-run forecast from your last 90 days and sketched a staged upgrade path that balances predictability with cost. High-level notes below; I attached the modeling workbook and a latency snapshot we pulled from Console.

Summary (90d):
- Token consumption: ~28.2M tokens (inference requests)
- Commit utilization: average 118% of current monthly baseline (spiky weekends)
- 95th pct latency: jumped to ~420ms during peak windows on last two deploys

Proposed short plan:
1) Pilot Dedicated pool (2x T4-equivalent slots) for 4 weeks to remove noisy multi-tenant variance and test batching/quantization gains.
2) If pilot meets latency & cost goals, move to 3-month reserved capacity (staged ramp) with pre-negotiated headroom bursts.
3) Lock a multi-quarter commit (with staged pricing) to secure unit cost discounts and capacity SLA.

I attached: quantile_runway_modeling.xlsx (forecast + tier math) and latency_report-sept.pdf. My ask: can Evan share procurement timelines and any SOW/PO requirements?

I’ll follow up with a concrete tier table and ROI numbers tomorrow.

Cheers,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132

Attachment stubs: quantile_runway_modeling.xlsx (xlsx), latency_report-sept.pdf (pdf)

From: Maggie Zhao <maggie@quantile.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Lin <procurement@quantile.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Usage health + staged upgrade proposal

Ben — thanks for the summary. A couple quick clarifying Qs before we dig into the workbook:

1) That 118% utilization — is that normalized to our digest API only or across all model endpoints? We have a new experimental endpoint that spikes occasionally.
2) The latency jump: is that correlated with specific model variants or request length? We need to understand risk to live traffic.

Procurement timeline: we typically need an SOW + 30 days for legal + PO cycle. Evan, feel free to correct me.

If you can send a line-item ROI that shows expected token unit change under the pilot vs current public API pricing, that’d help speed internal buy-in.

— Maggie
Maggie Zhao
CTO, Quantile Labs
maggie@quantile.ai

Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Usage health + staged upgrade proposal — ROI table attached

Maggie / Evan — attaching a compact ROI summary and proposed staged pricing (redwood-staged-pricing.pdf). Key highlights:

- Baseline (current public API): $0.60 per 1k tokens (avg effective after current discounts)
- Pilot (Dedicated + optimizations): projected effective $0.48 per 1k tokens during pilot due to batching and KV cache (≈20% savings)
- 3-month reserved stage (commit): projected effective $0.39 per 1k tokens (≈35% vs baseline) once we lock a 3-month ramp + modest 10% quantization on non-critical models

Economic example (monthly run-rate if throughput stays ~9.4M tokens/mo):
- Today: ~$5,640/mo
- Pilot: ~$4,512/mo (save ~$1,128/mo)
- Post-reserve: ~$3,666/mo (incremental annualized savings if adopted)

Operational benefits: lower 95th pct latency (~200–260ms observed in pilot sims), predictable capacity for bulk batch jobs, and straightforward rollback to public API if needed.

Next steps I propose:
- We run a 4-week pilot (Dedicated pool) starting week of 9/27.
- Redwood issues a one-page SOW for pilot + acceptance criteria; Quantile issues PO or expedited approval to start.

I’ve linked the detailed workbook in Drive (Quantile runway model). Let me know if Evan needs any legal contract template prepopulated.

Thanks,
Ben

Attachment stubs: redwood-staged-pricing.pdf (pdf)
Related link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1QNT-Runway-Model

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal — Quantile pilot ask + discount request (deal QNT-2027-0923)

Marissa / Soojin — quick internal note so we have thread context.

Quantile is asking for a 4-week Dedicated pilot beginning week of 9/27; expected baseline 9.4M tokens/month. They’ve asked for a line-item ROI and we provided: pilot ≈20% effective cost improvement; 3-month commit ≈35% improvement.

The procurement team will need an SOW and a PO; timeline likely ~30 days. Evan indicated legal loop but is open to a short pilot SOW to accelerate.

My ask: can we offer a one-time pilot credit or a 20% introductory discount on the pilot billing to reduce friction? This would be offset in our modeling by expected multi-quarter commit (deal_id QNT-2027-0923). If approved I’ll include the discount and final SOW.

I’m happy to jump on a 15-min sync if you want to run numbers live.

Thanks,
Ben
Account Executive

> Onboarding note: pilot SLA will be limited; escalation path with CS (Soojin) to be included in SOW.

From: Maggie Zhao <maggie@quantile.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Lin <procurement@quantile.ai>
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2027 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quantile runway & staged upgrade proposal — confirm pilot

Ben — thanks for the clear economics and for routing internally. We ran the ROI with our finance team and the numbers line up. We’d like to proceed with the 4-week Dedicated pilot starting 9/27. Evan will draft an initial PO; he’ll need an SOW and the payment terms.

Please include acceptance criteria that explicitly reference:
- Reduced 95th pct latency target: <= 300ms for digest API under steady traffic
- Token throughput stability during weekend peak windows
- A rollback plan to public API if we observe quality regressions after quantization

Evan, adding you to coordinate procurement details. Ben — if you can send the SOW + pilot SOW signature page today we’ll route the PO.

Thanks — Maggie

Evan Lin (procurement) <procurement@quantile.ai>
